newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Notionnel rally intact while 128.80 holds.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Notionnel rally intact while 128.80 holds.

text.p: June notionnel futures traded on MATIF will slink back on Wednesday to test support at 128.80, the April 9 high through which the market broke on Tuesday, technical analysts said.
However, as long as the market does not fall through that level, the positive tone created by the break will still permeate the market, they said.

"The outlook shifted after notionnel broke above 128.80 to become more positive," said Raynard Cheng, technical analyst at First Chicago in London. "It may need to fall back first, but it will still be able to push higher."
He said the target of the rally was 129.34, a 50 percent Fibonacci retracement of the fall from a high of 131.58 on February 18 to a low of 127.06 on April 4.
Above there, a 61.8 percent retracement of the same rally gives a target of 129.86, and analysts said that was likely to act as resistance.
Analysts at Deutsche in London said there was potentially a reverse head-and-shoulders pattern forming with the 128.96 resistance serving as a neckline.
"However, the volume/open interest patterns do not provide strong confirmation," Deutsche analysts said in a client note.
June notionnel futures were up 12 at 129.14 by 0835.
Below 128.80, Cheng said the market would start to look "messy" with the next line of support provided by 128.50, an intraday trendline and also where a block of price action was centred.
Deutsche saw support at 128.70, and below there at daily uptrend support at 128.28.
June Pibor was unchanged at 96.70. Analysts said it must break resistance at 96.71 for a final move higher to 96.77.
